title: Send a Proton email (private)
description: Logs into a Proton account handed off by a session (account.json in a content store) and sends one email whose recipient, subject and body are AES-encrypted files (Encrypt to a content store). Decrypts in memory, sends the body as HTML text, prints only sent/failed. No AI ever sees the key or the inputs.

fields.name: account
fields.label: Account store
fields.help: Content store holding account.json (username + password), written by the signup session (proton_after.py --handoff).

fields.name: inputs
fields.label: Inputs store
fields.help: Content store holding the encrypted address.txt (recipient), subject.txt and content.txt (plain-text body).

fields.name: keystore
fields.label: Key store
fields.help: The store holding the AES_KEY the inputs were encrypted with.
